headline: Christa Pike’s lawyers in court after she regains consciousness in hospital – latest updates

members.title: Christa Pike’s lawyers in court after she regains consciousness in hospital – latest updates
members.lead: Tennessee prisoner awake and speaking after surviving state’s attempt to execute her last Wednesday Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after botched execution attempt, lawyers say Judge I’Ashea Myles said the state has agreed that the Davidson county court has the authority to hear the case. She will now officially reopen it. Christa Pike’s lawyer, Luke Ihnen, is now going through the complaints her team has filed, pointing out issues in the botched execution protocol and the qualifications of prison staff. members.title: Judge orders officials to preserve all evidence tied to Christa Pike’s botched execution
members.lead: Judge tells Tennessee officials all items in execution room must be saved as Pike remains restrained in hospital bed A judge ordered Tennessee officials on Wednesday to preserve all evidence related to the botched execution attempt on convicted murderer Christa Pike, as it emerged that the state has refused pleas from medical staff to allow her to be unshackled from her hospital bed. At a hearing in Nashville on Wednesday, judge I’Ashea Myles said: “Anything that was in the actual room” during the attempted execution a week ago must be preserved by the state, including all drugs, intravenous lines and tubing used in the death chamber.
